AUTH_HOST.name: AUTH_HOST
AUTH_HOST.description: Private domain for the auth (GoTrue) service. Kong proxies /auth/v1/* requests here.

REST_HOST.name: REST_HOST
REST_HOST.description: Private domain for the rest (PostgREST) service. Kong proxies /rest/v1/* requests here.

REALTIME_HOST.name: REALTIME_HOST
REALTIME_HOST.description: Private domain for the realtime service. Kong proxies /realtime/v1/* requests here.

STORAGE_HOST.name: STORAGE_HOST
STORAGE_HOST.description: Private domain for the storage service. Kong proxies /storage/v1/* requests here.

KONG_PROXY_LISTEN.name: KONG_PROXY_LISTEN
KONG_PROXY_LISTEN.description: Kong proxy listen address. Uses Railway-injected ${{PORT}} so health checks and external traffic can reach it.

PORT.name: PORT
PORT.description: Railway-injected port. Kong proxy listens on this port.
